name: JobDist
description: Distributed job scheduler (.NET 10): REST API + MCP server over the same business logic.
authentication: Header X-Api-Key (roles: Admin, Submitter, Viewer, Worker, AiAgent) or Authorization: Bearer <AuthServer token> with jobdist.* permissions. Worker calls also need X-Worker-Token from registration.
versioning: URL segment api/v1/...; the unversioned api/... alias equals v1. Header api-version or query ?api-version also accepted.

Whether an AI provider is configured (anonymous: the web console reads it before sign-in to show or hide the assistant).
Answers a chat with read-only JobDist tools filtered by the caller's permissions (503 when not configured).
All recipients (addresses masked).
One recipient.
Creates a recipient (send header `Idempotency-Key` so a retry does not create a second one).
Updates a recipient; `version` is required (409 when someone else saved first). Empty address keeps the stored one.
Deletes a recipient.
Sends a test message to the recipient now.
Channels enabled on MessageHub (empty when MessageHub is not configured).
Alert event types.
Alert history (X1), newest first.
Accepts 1-50 entries; the server adds user id, client IP and user agent itself.
Submits a job.

Parameters.Description: Job type, payload, priority, optional target worker, retries, timeout, schedule time.

Distribution history (attempts, workers, timings).

Risk (0-100) that the job fails / is delayed, with explained factors.

Job types registered by online workers or waiting in the queue (for pickers).
ML-DSA-65 + ECDSA-P384 public keys.
All thresholds.

Current pending jobs against every threshold (dashboard).
Job statistics by day (in timeZone), job type and/or worker.

MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint (stateless JSON-RPC). Tools listed below.

mcpTools.name: assess_job_risk
mcpTools.description: Calculate the risk (0-100) that a job fails, is delayed or is lost: no capable/online worker, strict target offline, backlog vs capacity, historical failure rate, expected duration vs timeout, attempts already used, unstable assigned worker. Returns score, level, factors and a recommendation.

mcpTools.name: assess_submission_risk
mcpTools.description: What-if: calculate the risk (0-100) of submitting a job of the given type BEFORE creating it (capability, redundancy, backlog, history, timeout, encryption keys for sensitive payloads). Nothing is created.

targetWorkerId.description: Optional worker id (GUID) that should run the job.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout per attempt in seconds (null = server default).

sensitive.description: true when the payload is confidential (needs encrypted delivery).

mcpTools.name: assess_worker_risk
mcpTools.description: Calculate the health risk (0-100) of a worker: availability, network instability (offline count), learned failure rate per job type, CPU/memory pressure and missing post-quantum keys.

mcpTools.name: detect_anomalies
mcpTools.description: Detect abnormal job distribution in a recent window: submission spikes (z-score), high failure rates per job type or worker, slow execution, flapping workers, fail-over storms, queues without capable workers and suspicious worker reports.

mcpTools.name: recommend_workers
mcpTools.description: Rank online workers for a job type with the scheduler's own scoring (load, ML-predicted speed and reliability, exploration). Explains why each worker is ranked.

mcpTools.name: get_job_status
mcpTools.description: Get the status of a job: state, priority, assigned worker, attempts, timings, result or last error.

mcpTools.name: list_jobs
mcpTools.description: List recent jobs, optionally filtered by status (Pending, Assigned, Running, Succeeded, Failed, CancelRequested, Cancelled) and job type.

mcpTools.name: get_job_history
mcpTools.description: Get the distribution history of a job: every attempt with worker, queue wait, duration, outcome and scheduler score.

mcpTools.name: list_workers
mcpTools.description: List registered workers with status, capabilities (job types and concurrency), machine spec, current load and stability.

mcpTools.name: get_cluster_summary
mcpTools.description: Get a cluster overview: workers online/draining/offline, capacity, jobs by status, pending jobs per type and the current HA leader.

mcpTools.name: get_worker_performance
mcpTools.description: Get what the ML model learned about worker performance per job type: samples, success/failure counts, mean and standard deviation of duration.

mcpTools.name: get_queue_status
mcpTools.description: Get pending jobs compared with the configured queue thresholds: pending, limit, usage percent and level (Normal, NearLimit, OverLimit). Over the limit, new jobs of that type are rejected.

mcpTools.name: list_alert_logs
mcpTools.description: List alerts sent to administrators through MessageHub in the last hours: event type, severity, title, recipient (masked address) and delivery status.

eventType.description: Optional event type: AnomalyDetected, WorkerRegistered, WorkerUnregistered, WorkerLost, LeaderChanged, QueueNearLimit, QueueOverLimit, Test.

mcpTools.name: get_job_statistics
mcpTools.description: Job statistics per day (Asia/Bangkok), job type or worker: submitted, succeeded, failed, cancelled, success rate, average attempts, average and P95 duration, average queue wait, throughput per hour. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd; range at most the retention period (30 days).

groupBy.description: Grouping: day, jobType, worker or a comma-separated combination.

mcpTools.name: submit_job
mcpTools.description: Submit a new job. Only available when the operator enabled side-effect tools. Use assess_submission_risk first.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key so retries do not create duplicates.

mcpTools.name: cancel_job
mcpTools.description: Cancel a job. If a worker is running it, the server sends the worker a signed cancel command. Only available when side-effect tools are enabled.

mcpTools.name: change_job_priority
mcpTools.description: Change the priority (0-100) of a job that has not finished. Only available when side-effect tools are enabled.

Members.Description: How long a completion report is retried while the server is unreachable before it is dropped.

Members.Name: ShutdownGracePeriod
Members.Description: Time given to running jobs to finish during shutdown before they are cancelled.
